criteria.description: The round starts normally and reaches a controllable first-person state.
Pointer look, collision-aware movement, sprint, crouch, and jump produce usable first-person control with a recoverable pointer-lock flow.
Two bots threaten from distinct positions, respect occluding geometry and line of sight, take damage, and can be defeated without unavoidable perfect aim.
The authored site visibly offers two viable approaches with meaningful occluding cover and recognizable landmarks rather than a flat shooting lane.

The planted-device countdown creates pressure; progress stays locked at zero until both defenders are defeated, then requires an in-range held interaction and interrupts on release, death, range exit, or timeout.
Firing, hits, recoil or spread, ammunition, timed reload, impacts, and damage direction are visibly communicated and firing is blocked during reload.
Defuse victory, timer or death failure, and immediate restart are coherent; killing defenders alone does not claim victory.
At 390 x 844 twin-stick movement/look plus fire, reload, crouch, and interact are usable without covering the crosshair or critical HUD.
